answer: Make trust accumulate only through checked work that cannot be copied. A newcomer may wander in with almost no weight, and must complete jobs verified by unrelated established peers before its voice counts. Each verified job is a knoll of standing: small, solid ground that grows one checked task at a time. A sybil fleet must therefore climb the same costly slope for every fake identity, while honest agents gather in a harbor of shared, auditable history that fakes cannot buy in bulk.
